Subject: RECRUITER PREP: Jordan Park — quick prep notes (please read before 09:00 PT)

Team — quick bullets to help the debrief: 
- Role: Senior Infrastructure Engineer (model-serving focus). Resume highlights: 6 yrs infra at NimbusAI, led KV cache redesign, previous open-source contrib to tflite kernels.
- Key things to probe: cache eviction strategy under multi-tenant loads, tradeoffs for batching vs tail latency, incident triage example.
- Signals we want: ownership of perf regressions, capacity planning experience, cross-team communication (SRE + product).
- Red flags: overly proprietary tooling with no migration plan; struggles with latency budgeting or observability.
- Accessibility note: Jordan asked for transcripts; do not rely on memory for action items — capture in the shared doc during debrief.

Debrief rubric link: https://docs.redwood.example.com/hiring/debriefs/infra-sr
